_comment: Motive der Lexikon-Beispielbilder (tools/lexicon.py). Bewusst einfach, damit die Bilder auch klein lesbar bleiben. Kategorien in 'categories' bekommen das Infomotiv, alle anderen die Szene. Eine Änderung macht alle Lexikonbilder des Motivs ungültig.

motifs.motif_en: On a rocky island shore, a lighthouse keeper, a woman of about 60 with short grey hair, wearing a thick blue wool sweater, stands in the open doorway of a small white lighthouse with a broom in her hand. A black-and-white dog sits beside her. A wooden rowing boat lies pulled up on the rocks, and two gulls fly over the sea. Viewpoint, light, time of day, season and framing are the style's choice.

A one-page visitor information sheet for a fictional island, titled 'LORNHOLM' at the top. Three numbered items, each with one simple picture and one word: 1 'Ferry' (a small ferry boat), 2 'Lighthouse' (a lighthouse), 3 'Market' (a market stall with a striped awning). Layout, lettering, pictures and how the items are connected are the style's choice.
